{"instruction": "Replace the four semicircular rounded protrusions with straight rectangular protrusions, removing the arcs and forming flat-ended arms with the same width as the previous cap diameter.", "original_source": "import cadquery as cq
half_width = 10.96
outer_radius = 27.4
cap_radius = half_width
cap_center = outer_radius - cap_radius
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(cap_center, half_width)
    .threePointArc((outer_radius, 0.0), (cap_center, -half_width))
    .lineTo(half_width, -half_width)
    .lineTo(half_width, -cap_center)
    .threePointArc((0.0, -outer_radius), (-half_width, -cap_center))
    .lineTo(-half_width, -half_width)
    .lineTo(-cap_center, -half_width)
    .threePointArc((-outer_radius, 0.0), (-cap_center, half_width))
    .lineTo(-half_width, half_width)
    .lineTo(-half_width, cap_center)
    .threePointArc((0.0, outer_radius), (half_width, cap_center))
    .lineTo(half_width, half_width)
    .lineTo(cap_center, half_width)
    .close()
    .extrude(7.4)
)
